title: A Biophysical Study of Ru(II) Polypyridyl Complex, Properties and its Interaction with DNA.
authors: Nambigari, Navaneetha; Kodipaka, Aruna; Vuradi, Ravi Kumar; Airva, Praveen Kumar; Sirasani, Satyanarayana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ru(II)多吡啶配合物与DNA的嵌入结合，采用分子对接和光谱方法，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作可迁移的分子对接建模研究。
abstract: Mononuclear Ru(II)Polypyridyl complexes of type [Ru(A)(2)BPIIP] (ClO(4))(2).2H(2)O, where BPIIP = 2-(3-(4-bromophenyl)isoxazole-5-yl)-1 H-imidazo [4,5-f] [1, 10] phenanthroline and A = bpy = bipyridyl (1), phen = 1,10 Phenanthroline (2), dmb = 4, 4' -dimethyl 2, 2'- bipyridine (3) & dmp = 4,4'-dimethyl-1,10 -Ortho Phenanthroline (4), were synthesized and their antibacterial activity were examined. The synthesized complexes were characterized and their interaction with DNA was studied using Computational and Biophysical methods (Absorption, emission methods, and viscosity). Molecular modelling studies were carried out for molecular geometry and electronic properties (Frontier molecular orbital HOMO-LUMO). The electrostatic potential surface contours for the complexes were analysed to give their nucleophilic level of sensitivity. The study reveals that the Ru(II) Polypyridyl complexes bind to DNA preponderantly by intercalation. The results recommend that the phen and dmp complex have more effective binding ability than the bpy and dmb, indicating the role of the ancillary ligand in determining their specificity for DNA binding. Further molecular docking studies suggested an octahedral geometry and bind to DNA by preferential binding to Guanine. The docking study additionally sustains the binding constant data acquired with the absorption and emission techniques.The results reveal that the nature of the ancillary Ligand plays a considerable role for the intercalation of the Ru(II) polypyridyl complex to DNA, which subsequently influences the antibacterial activity. Biological studies conducted on Gram-Negative (E.coli and K.pneumonia) and Gram-Positive (S. aureus and E. faecalis) bacteria establish that complex 1 and 2 were considerably active against S. aureus and E. coli.
abstract_zh: 合成了类型为[Ru(A)(2)BPIIP](ClO(4))(2).2H(2)O的单核Ru(II)多吡啶配合物，其中BPIIP = 2-(3-(4-溴苯基)异噁唑-5-基)-1H-咪唑并[4,5-f][1,10]菲咯啉，A = bpy = 联吡啶 (1)，phen = 1,10-菲咯啉 (2)，dmb = 4,4'-二甲基-2,2'-联吡啶 (3) 及 dmp = 4,4'-二甲基-1,10-邻菲咯啉 (4)，并检测了其抗菌活性。对合成的配合物进行了表征，并采用计算和生物物理方法（吸收法、发射法和粘度法）研究了它们与DNA的相互作用。进行了分子建模研究以确定分子几何结构和电子性质（前沿分子轨道HOMO-LUMO）。分析了配合物的静电势表面轮廓以评估其亲核敏感性。研究表明，Ru(II)多吡啶配合物主要通过嵌入方式与DNA结合。结果建议，phen和dmp配合物比bpy和dmb配合物具有更有效的结合能力，表明辅助配体在决定其DNA结合特异性中发挥作用。进一步的分子对接研究表明，这些配合物具有八面体几何结构，并通过优先结合鸟嘌呤与DNA结合。对接研究还支持了通过吸收和发射技术获得的结合常数数据。结果表明，辅助配体的性质对Ru(II)多吡啶配合物嵌入DNA起着重要作用，进而影响其抗菌活性。对革兰氏阴性菌（大肠杆菌和肺炎克雷伯菌）和革兰氏阳性菌（金黄色葡萄球菌和粪肠球菌）进行的生物学研究确定，配合物1和2对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌具有显著活性。
